specAmbiguitiesResolved: DATA-MODEL tenant_memberships.role is realised as site-scoped role_assignments rows referencing (tenant_id, user_id) memberships, so one member can hold several roles at different sites.

Roles: SECURITY.md minimum roles (viewer, operator, maintenance_approver, finance_approver, admin, auditor) plus engineer (INV-15 named engineer); 'approver' maps to maintenance_approver (PLAN_ACTION) and finance_approver (BUDGET_ADJUSTMENT). Services hold only 'worker', integrations only 'integration'; devices hold no roles (telemetry.ingest at their own site is implied).

DATA-MODEL tenant_policies is realised as policies (stable key AUTHORITY | RETENTION) plus immutable policy_revisions; ids use the contracts policyRevision prefix 'pol' and every reference column is policy_revision_id.

approvals.revoked_at is replaced by append-only approval_events (REVOKED | INVALIDATED | CONSUMED, unique per approval), so revocation/invalidation never edits the signed row; executable = no event and not expired.
'Immutable' revision tables that the spec gives superseded_at/valid_to columns allow exactly one NULL->value stamp on those columns and nothing else; fully append-only tables reject every UPDATE.
users.external_subject is globally unique per DATA-MODEL; issuer is stored and must match on sign-in.

FR-01 warranty, approved vendor and food-at-risk values are versioned through registry_revisions with zod-validated bodies (money as minor units + currency) instead of separate typed tables; typed tables carry identity data that other decisions bind to.

Denials that cannot resolve a resource (foreign or nonexistent) use the existing FORBIDDEN code with reasonCode RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE (contracts has no NOT_FOUND code); the caller's audit stores only a digest of the requested id. In-tenant site-scope read denials look identical.

X-Tenant-ID rejections and unknown webhook bindings are recorded in a platform security_audit_entries table (no tenant attribution, requested value as SHA-256 digest) because recording them under the requested tenant would itself test that tenant's existence.

Outbox delivery uses a committed lease (lease_owner/lease_expires_at) claimed with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED rather than holding a transaction open across the sink call; at-least-once delivery plus consumeOnce receipts gives once-logical processing keyed by eventId.
incident_id columns (approvals, evidence_revisions, ledger) are prefix-checked text until M04 creates incidents; M04 must add the composite (tenant_id, incident_id) FKs in its own migration.
Row-level security is not enabled: the dev role is a superuser (RLS would be bypassed and untestable). withTenantTransaction sets app.tenant_id for a later RLS policy as defence in depth.
unresolvedRisks: Privacy lifecycle is state only: legal holds and privacy requests are durable and holds block deletion/redaction requests, but no retention/erasure worker or cryptographic erasure of governed payloads exists yet; no owned test covers FR-23 directly.

Policy/procedure revisions beyond AUTHORITY and RETENTION (safety classes, thresholds, recovery windows, escalation, integration settings) need new policy keys and schemas from the modules that own them.
Machine tokens are HS256 with per-principal secrets; replay inside the 5-minute TTL is not prevented (no jti store). mTLS or a jti cache can be added behind the same verifier.
Asset identity change enqueues plan.revalidate_for_asset_revision jobs; no handler exists until M08.
T-010/T-011 over telemetry, signoffs, budget, attempts and recovery bindings must be re-run by M03/M09/M10/M11 against their tables (TEST-PLAN coverage rule).
